subject: Staffing decision brief: FY27 scaling scenarios
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Staffing decision brief: FY27 scaling scenarios

Team —

Attached are two high-level scenarios for our FY27 scaling plan (scaling_scenarios_v1.xlsx). I summarized the trade-offs below so we can lock decisions before QBR prep next week. Please review and flag concerns by EOD Wed (Mar 3).

Quick summary:
- Scenario A — Focused growth: approve 6 hires prioritized to customer-facing and infra (expected headcount +6, runway impact: -$3.2M).
- Scenario B — Conservative: approve 2 backfills only (core infra +1, CS backfill +1), hiring freeze on new exploratory roles (runway impact: -$1.1M).

Questions for leadership:
1) Approve Scenario A or B? If A, which reqs are highest priority (list below).
2) Any exceptions to the freeze we should mark as "mission critical"?

Priority reqs attached: req_4515_summary.pdf (infra backfill), notes for exploratory research reqs are in the sheet.

Context: StudioEdge renewal conversation is progressing — Sales & Finance asked for clear staffing plan for the dedicated deployment commit. We need to present a recommended headcount stance at the QBR on Mar 9.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: scaling_scenarios_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), req_4515_summary.pdf (document)

From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Staffing decision brief: FY27 scaling scenarios

Priya —

Thanks for pulling this together. Quick reactions after a read-through:

- I lean toward Scenario B (Conservative) with two caveats: we prioritize the infra backfill (req_4515) and one CS IC to keep StudioEdge onboarding timelines intact.
- Freeze new exploratory roles for Q2 — we can re-evaluate in June if revenue signals improve.
- If Finance is comfortable with the smaller hit, we can defer the rest. Michael, can you confirm runway impact assumptions in the spreadsheet?

Also: for transparency, I'd like a short note for Execs listing the candidate lead times per req (2–6 weeks for CS, 6–10 weeks for senior infra). Helps set expectations at the QBR.

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Staffing decision brief: FY27 scaling scenarios

Agree with the conservative posture as the default. A couple operational notes:

- Approve req_4515 (infra) as priority backfill. We should also greenlight req_4521 (platform SRE backfill) — both are blockers for our capacity targets.
- For customer-facing roles, approve the CS backfill but hold on any new SDR/AE expansions until after StudioEdge commits.
- I'll prepare a one-pager (internal) on risk to delivery timelines if we delay the platform SRE hire; will share by EOD Tue.

If Finance pushes back, we can present a phased plan: immediate approval for infra + CS backfill, contingent approval for SRE pending cost review.

—Laura
VP, Engineering

Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 13:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Staffing decision brief: FY27 scaling scenarios

Adding cost/impact detail from my side:

- Approving req_4515 and req_4521 gives us the minimal capacity to hit StudioEdge onboarding SLOs; compute spend will increase ~7% but can be offset by short-term reserved instance optimization.
- Research/experimental hires (exploratory) have the highest variance in near-term impact — recommend deferring until after Q3 OKR check.

I've attached a short note with the SRE role checklist and expected ramp time (req_4521_backfill_note.txt). If we want Scenario A, we should identify a clear revenue-tied hire list; otherwise, go conservative.

Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 17:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Staffing decision brief: FY27 scaling scenarios — Final decision and actions

Thanks all — finalizing decisions so the GTM/QBR slides can be updated. Summary and next steps: 

Decisions (approved):
- Approve req_4515 (infra backfill) — immediate recruiter outreach.
- Approve req_4521 (platform SRE backfill) — conditional approval; Michael to confirm cost offsets by Fri Mar 5.

Temporary constraints (approved):
- Hiring freeze on new exploratory/research headcount through end of Q2 (exceptions require Exec approval).
- No new SDR/AE expansions until StudioEdge signs the committed deployment contract.

Action items:
- Michael: validate the runway/cost offsets in the sheet and confirm by 2027-03-05 (JIRA-REQ-4515).
- Laura: one-pager on delivery risk if SRE is delayed — due 2027-03-04 and will be added to the QBR packet.
- Markus: draft a 1-slide candidate lead time table for Execs — due 2027-03-05.
- Rishi: handoff SRE ramp plan to hiring manager and attach req_4521_backfill_note.txt to the req.
- Priya: update QBR slides and push approved headcount plan to the Exec packet (Drive link below).

Links and references: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3Cscaling | JIRA-REQ-4515 | DOCUSIGN-EXCEPTION-3032

If anyone feels strongly we should go with Scenario A, flag now — otherwise we proceed as above. I'll include this summary in the QBR packet and share with Sales/Finance for StudioEdge conversation prep.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: req_4515_summary.pdf, req_4521_backfill_note.txt
